title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via eval (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, eval turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The ruby-specific remedy is data-only handling via JSON parsing or a dispatch table.
applicability: ruby codebases that build code or expressions from strings via eval; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
